cards.text: Friend, a LARGE crowd is gathering, with people coming to Jesus from town after town. While they gather, He tells them a parable. It starts simple: a farmer goes out to sow his seed.

cards.question: As the farmer sows, some seed falls along the path. What happens to it?

answers.text: It gets trampled and eaten by birds
It sinks in and sprouts overnight
It washes away in the rain

cards.text: Some seed falls on rocky ground, and it actually comes up. That's me doing a victory hop on my gold base over a batch that looks PERFECT on top, right before I flip one over.

cards.question: The seedlings on the rocky ground wither because they have no ___.
Other seed falls among thorns. True or false: the thorns grow up with the seedlings and choke them.

cards.text: Still other seed falls on good soil, and it springs up and produces a crop. FINALLY, somebody in this story is having a good day.

cards.question: How big is the crop the seed on the good soil produces?

cards.text: As Jesus says this, He calls out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear." And that's where the farmer's story ends.

cards.question: Then the disciples of Jesus ask Him a question about the farmer and the seed. What do they ask?

cards.text: Honestly, RESPECT, because every one of us has nodded through a whole meeting and then whispered to a coworker, "Wait, what did we just agree to?" The disciples skip all that and go straight to Jesus, and He answers them.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells His disciples that the knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of God has been kept from them.

cards.text: To others, Jesus says, He speaks in parables, so that, "though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand." Those words go back to Isaiah 6:9, and friend, this one's worth chewing on.
Now Jesus explains it: the seed is the word of God. Friend, I LOVE an answer key, because I spent years in a junk drawer full of instruction manuals, and not ONE of them ever explained anything.
First, the seeds along the path, the ones the birds got. Those are people who hear, but then someone comes and takes the word away from their hearts.

cards.question: Who comes and takes the word away from the hearts of the people along the path?

cards.text: The devil takes it so that they may not believe and be saved. Next, the rocky ground: people who hear the word and receive it with joy, and I picture them front row, hands up, the WHOLE thing.

cards.question: The rocky-ground people receive the word with joy, but Jesus says they have no ___.
True or false: when the time of testing comes, the rocky-ground people stand firm.

cards.text: They believe for a season, but in the time of testing, they fall away. Then the thorns: these people hear too, but as they go on their way, they get choked.

cards.question: Jesus says the people among the thorns are choked by the ___, riches, and pleasures of this life.

cards.text: And Jesus says their fruit does not mature. That's me pulling a batch out early because ten other things grabbed my mustache at once, and friend, the middle is still DOUGH.
And finally, the good soil: people with a noble and good heart who hear the word. These are the ones who produce a crop.

cards.question: What do the good-soil people do with the word they hear?

answers.text: Hear it once and move on

cards.text: Then Jesus switches to a new picture. Someone lights a lamp.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says a person who lights a lamp sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.

cards.text: Jesus says no one lights a lamp and covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed. That's like turning on your phone's flashlight and shoving the phone right back in your pocket, and who's that helping? NOBODY.

cards.question: Jesus keeps going about hidden and concealed things. What does He say happens to them?

answers.text: They will all be brought to light
They will fade and be forgotten

cards.question: Jesus is wrapping up. What does He tell His listeners to pay attention to?

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "Whoever has will be given more…" Lean in for the second half, friend.

cards.question: Jesus says that whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be ___ from him.
